items.title: 정부, 올해 국가자격시험 전수조사 실시…세무사 시험 부정행위자는 5년간 응시 제한
items.excerpt: 고용노동부가 비상대책회의를 열고 올해 국가자격시험 AI 활용 부정행위 전수조사와 제63회 세무사 시험 부정행위자 합격 취소·5년 응시 제한 등 후속대책을 마련했다.
items.rationale: Korean government orders a full audit of AI-assisted cheating across all national licensing exams this year and cancels the tax-accountant exam result with a 5-year ban - the concrete government action in the AI-exam-cheating story (single card for that cluster).

items.title: 홍콩, AI 안면인식 감시망 가동…용의자 동선 실시간 추적
items.excerpt: 홍콩 경찰이 인공지능(AI)을 활용한 안면인식 감시망을 가동해 용의자 동선을 실시간으로 추적한다.
items.rationale: Hong Kong police switch on an AI facial-recognition surveillance network for real-time suspect tracking - a state deployment of AI surveillance, distinct from the UK watchdog report that ran 11-15.

items.title: 중기부, '모두의 창업' 개인정보 유출 업체 제재 추진…AI 공급기업 긴급 보안점검
items.excerpt: 중기부가 '모두의 창업' 참가자 개인정보 유출 사고를 낸 민간 AI 솔루션 공급업체에 선정 취소 등 제재를 검토하고 나머지 AI 공급기업 긴급 보안점검에 나선다.
items.rationale: Korea's SME ministry moves to sanction the AI solution vendor behind a startup-program data leak and orders emergency security checks of all its AI suppliers - a procurement/privacy enforcement step for vendors selling AI to government programs.

items.title: Congress wants to tighten export rules on AI chips after Nvidia spy scandal
items.excerpt: Jensen Huang's relationship with a suspected Chinese spy has Congress ready to crack down, with lawmakers moving to tighten export rules on advanced AI chips to China.
items.rationale: The single Nvidia/Megaspeed card today: the legislative response - lawmakers moving to tighten AI-chip export rules to China - rather than further allegations or officials' reactions.

items.title: DOJ takes aim at $1.2B in Binance loot as FBI disrupts North Korean scam
items.excerpt: DOJ moves to seize $1.2B from the Binance hack; the FBI ties North Korea's 'FaceStealer' deepfake video-call scam to $400M+ in theft and 900+ webcam recordings.
items.rationale: US enforcement action: the FBI disrupts North Korea's 'FaceStealer' deepfake video-call operation (attributed $400M+ theft) alongside a DOJ forfeiture move - state-backed deepfake fraud meets law enforcement; writer should lead with the deepfake angle.

https://www.etnews.com/20261115000178.new_action: Government emergency meeting decides a full audit of AI-assisted cheating across this year's national licensing exams, plus cancellation of the 63rd tax-accountant exam pass and a 5-year exam ban for the offender (new official decision; prior cards covered AI-glasses warnings before the CSAT and 4 secondary students zeroed).

https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-i.new_action: Congressional move to tighten export rules on advanced AI chips to China (legislative response), distinct from the 11-07 Huang summons, 11-08 Megaspeed entity-list gap, 11-13 SEA licence rule and 11-14 Malaysia probe.
